continuity_state: Rook replaced Sable's tribute demand with a one-cycle tool trade after the mixed human-dog Bite Key proved valuable. He and the warehouse dogs helped repel the municipal retrieval team, then became a one-charge conditional ally and described Vesper's emerging pack hierarchy. A System-made false Nika used a legacy Bond permission and her private Hearth marker to request administrative access. The real Nika returned through the service passage and proved herself by repeating the unmeasured shelter ritual: sitting apart and allowing Mriya to choose approach. Rook destroyed the impostor seed. Bond remains 0, but Nika and Mriya's trust has materially recovered.
